name: Regolith ore processor
brief: MK-007 Regolith ore processor. Round 2, matched to the pick: a chunky framed furnace block on four splayed legs, a hopper on top, a glowing furnace mouth at the front with a tray of sintered bricks, an exhaust elbow on the side and a warm side window. Diegetic: the mouth glows while it cooks, the stack puffs slow dust, and bricks pile up on the tray.

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
Rebuilt against the Midjourney pick: chunky off-white modules held by dark bumper frames (bkit.module), warm orange windows (bkit.window), darker ground. Round 1 kept in round1/.
